agenda_items.title: Proposed Lane Closure –1000 Block University Drive Varsity View Neighbourhood [CC2026-0404]
agenda_items.content: ​Mayor Block introduced the matter.  A motion putting forward the recommendations was made and a motion to consider first reading of Bylaw No. 10170 was passed. Terry Schmidt, General Manager, Transportation and Construction, reviewed the report. Along with Jay Magus, Director of Transportation, they responded to questions of Council regarding rear lane access for vehicles such as waste removal truck and moving vans, design standards, and clarification on who is paying for the lane paving. Council heard from Craig Ayers, Ronald McDonald House, on this matter.
agenda_items.recommendation: That City Council consider Bylaw No. 10170 - The Street Closing Bylaw, 2026; That after closure, the former right-of-way be transferred to Friends of Saskatchewan Children Inc./Ronald McDonald House Saskatchewan Inc.; and That all costs associated with closure be paid by the applicant.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (10) Councillor Davies, Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Donauer, Mayor Block, Councillor Dubois, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Ford, Councillor Parker, Councillor Pearce, and Councillor Timon Absent: (1) Councillor MacDonald CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY (10 to 0)
